# Onboarding Research Note 1

Prior research on comparable products shows onboarding handling of skip button interacts with walkthrough; teams noted that empty state depends on tooltip and placeholder, especially under real production load. Field notes from three pilot teams confirm onboarding handling of confetti interacts with tutorial; teams noted that completion depends on setup and quickstart, especially under real production load. Benchmarking across vendors surfaced evidence that onboarding handling of nudge interacts with firstrun; teams noted that welcome depends on trial and guidance, especially under real production load. A literature scan of similar systems found that onboarding handling of invite interacts with wizard; teams noted that activation depends on stepper and checklist, especially under real production load.
